title: Universal relative purity by absence of associated-point impurities
statement: Work over $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ with schemes [def-pc-scheme], algebraic spaces [def-trf-algebraic-space] and the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Use sheaf fibre products [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers], quasi-coherent modules on small etale ringed sites [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module], and tensor pullback and direct image [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. Let $X$ be an algebraic space and $Y$ a scheme, and let $f:X\to Y$ be finite type and quasi-separated, with finite type as in [def-sfb-space-morphism-properties] and quasi-separated meaning that the diagonal is quasi-compact. Let $M$ be a finite type quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module; finite type means locally finitely generated on etale scheme charts. For a scheme $B\to Y$ put $X_B=X\times_YB$, let $M_B$ be tensor pullback, and let $f_B:X_B\to B$ be the projection. Define $\operatorname{Ass}_{X_B/B}(M_B)$ to consist of the images of points $u\in\operatorname{Ass}_{U/B}(M_B|_U)$ as $U\to X_B$ ranges over representable etale scheme charts, where the scheme relative assassin is [def-trf-relative-assassin]. Use the point classes and topology of [def-a1-space-point-topology]. A specialization $b\prime\leadsto b$ means $b\in\overline{\{b\prime\}}$. An impurity consists of a scheme $B\to Y$, such a specialization in $B$, and $\xi\in\operatorname{Ass}_{X_B/B}(M_B)$ with $f_B(\xi)=b\prime$ and $b\notin f_B(\overline{\{\xi\}})$. The module $M$ is universally pure relative to $Y$ if there are no impurities: for every such $B,b\prime,b,\xi$, there is a point $\theta\in\overline{\{\xi\}}\subseteq|X_B|$ with $f_B(\theta)=b$.

lean.note: The module defines the chartwise relative assassin and impurity predicate, and universal purity by specialization lifts after every scheme base change. Existing schemeSpace, enlargedFibreProduct/enlargedFibreProductFst and schemeRestriction are reused; their landed definition owners are added to stmt_deps. The original statement is unchanged. The relative assassin is the union over representable étale charts of Scheme.Modules.relativeAssassin along the canonical Yoneda-preimage chart map, with schemeRestriction.
